name: Paradise Energy Solutions
old_description: Means that the equipment for your new solar array is 100% exempt from MD sales and use taxes
about:
Paradise Energy Solutions operates from two Maryland branch offices in Hagerstown and Salisbury, where it serves as a family-owned, full-service solar energy company. The business lists Jason Beiler as a solar consultant and owner among a staff that includes project managers, foremen, electricians, and dedicated service technicians.

The company designs and installs custom solar arrays for commercial, agricultural, and residential customers. Its service division, branded Paradise Protect, provides annual performance analysis with recommendations, routine system checkups, and ongoing maintenance. The team handles the full project lifecycle from consultation and engineering through permitting, installation, and incentive paperwork.

Customers span Maryland businesses, farms, and homeowners seeking to offset electricity costs. The firm assists with Solar Renewable Energy Certificates (SRECs), the 30 percent federal investment tax credit for commercial projects, USDA loans and grants for qualifying agricultural installations, and the state sales-and-use tax exemption on solar equipment.

Founded on a family-ownership model, Paradise Energy emphasizes a single-point-of-contact approach that combines design, installation, and long-term service under one roof. The company states its goal is to help people save money with solar energy while delivering reliable, locally supported systems.
